script:
Good evening. This is your global conflict briefing.

BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT:
- India: 3 aircraft carriers, jets & troops: Israel, US plan to attack Iran after midterms.
- Africa: Ukraine: At least 9 people were killed in Russian attacks over the past 24 hours.
- South Asia: 4 cops including DSP martyred, 2 terrorists killed during exchange of fire in KP's Karak: police.

Full breakdown follows.

- Jamaica Gleaner, 20 hours ago: Holness blasts ‘two-mouth people’, defends JCF.
Prime Minister Dr Andrew Holness yesterday launched a blistering attack on critics of law enforcement, blasting “two-mouth people” while declaring his unwavering support for the Jamaica Constabulary Force (JCF). Holness comments come amid public debate over last Friday’s deadly gun battle in Sligoville, St Catherine. Speaking at a handover ceremony for the East Palms housing development in Kingston Central, Holness said state intervention was bringing positive changes to inner-city communities.

- Balkan Insight, 19 hours ago: Acquittal Fuels Doubts over Transfer of Bosnian War Crimes Cases to Serbia.

ASIA
India - bottom line: 3 aircraft carriers, jets & troops: Israel, US plan to attack Iran after midterms.
- Times of India - Top Stories, Jerusalem Post, 21 hours ago: 3 aircraft carriers, jets & troops: Israel, US plan to attack Iran after midterms.
The United States and Israel are preparing for potential military strikes against Iran after the upcoming midterm elections. Iran has announced it will reveal a new weapon called the 'Father of All Bombs' as tensions rise. US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth met Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to discuss military options recently. Meanwhile, Iranian officials warn of severe responses if attacked, emphasizing improved missile capabilities.
- Times of India - Top Stories, 2 hours ago: 'He put it back': Trump says Ukraine's Starlink restored, stays silent on Musk.
Ukraine depends heavily on Starlink for communications between military units, coordinating operations and receiving early warnings during Russian missile attacks. The satellite-based network also supports the use of drones, which Ukraine deploys both to strike Russian targets and to defend against incoming attacks. Disruptions to connectivity can therefore affect the military's ability to operate drones and respond to Russian assaults.
- Times of India - Top Stories, 13 hours ago: Iran claims 7 oil tankers damaged in Hormuz, warns strikes if US helps passage.
Seven oil tankers sustained damage in the Strait of Hormuz as a result of attacks and naval mines. Four of the tankers reportedly caught fire while transferring oil, creating significant challenges. Iranian authorities have warned of potential targeting of US bases if the situation escalates.
- Times of India - Top Stories, 4 hours ago: Indian dies in Saudi airport strike; MEA slams infrastructure attacks.
India has condemned the continued attacks on civilian and energy infrastructure. “These attacks have unfortunately resulted in civilian deaths and injuries. We convey our heartfelt condolences to the bereaved family and wish speedy recovery to those injured. The Indian embassy in Riyadh...will provide all possible assistance,” said ministry of external affairs (MEA) in a statement. The victim has not been identified by Saudi authorities so far.
South Asia - bottom line: 4 cops including DSP martyred, 2 terrorists killed during exchange of fire in KP's Karak: police.
- Dawn (Pakistan), 6 hours ago: 4 cops including DSP martyred, 2 terrorists killed during exchange of fire in KP's Karak: police.
LAKKI MARWAT: Four policemen, including two officials, were martyred and two terrorists were killed during an exchange of fire in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s Karak district on Thursday, police said. A statement by the KP police said law enforcers had initiated a search and strike operation in the Charpara area at noon, where terrorists had set up a blockade on Wednesday night.
- Dawn (Pakistan), 22 hours ago: Saudis intercept more drones as conflict with Houthis spirals.
• Coalition downs six drones launched towards cities, including Madina, as interception debris kills two • Rebels deny ‘deep operations’ in Saudi territory • Iran says Egypt entering Yemen war makes situation ‘more difficult’ • Macron arrives in Riyadh for ‘surprise solidarity visit’ RIYADH: As the conflict between Saudi Arabia and Yemen’s Houthi movement continues to escalate, the Saudi-led coalition on Wednesday said it had intercepted six drones launched towards the kingdom, including in the Madina region.
- Dawn (Pakistan), 6 hours ago: Pakistan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Turkiye to meet European trio in Istanbul.
Turkiye will host an R-4 and an R-4+E-3 meeting of foreign ministers in Istanbul on October 23, the Turkish foreign ministry said on Thursday. The R-4 group, which comprises Pakistan, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye, emerged in March and has been focusing on regional security and mediation efforts between the United States and Iran. The E-3 group is a trio of European powers — France, Britain and Germany — that was set up more than 20 years ago to advance diplomatic coordination over Iran’s nuclear programme.
- Dawn (Pakistan), 7 hours ago: England's Brook hits record ODI double ton but Sri Lanka pull off epic chase in Rawalpindi clash.
England’s Harry Brook smashed the fastest double-century in One-Day International (ODI) history and became the first Englishman to score 200 in the format but Sri Lanka sealed a two-wicket win in their tri-series clash with one ball to spare in Rawalpindi on Thursday. The 27-year-old captain rewrote the record books by racing to his double hundred in 114 balls, surpassing the previous mark of 117 deliveries set by India’s Shubman Gill. In the process, Brook also eclipsed England’s highest individual ODI score of 182, held by all-rounder Ben Stokes.

More than 300 houses collapsed in the earthquake, which struck on Thursday at 10.33pm. Officials were still evaluating the damage, and disaster relief work was ongoing, Xinhua said.
